interface.longDescription:
Send and read WhatsApp messages from your AI agent, using your own WhatsApp number.

What you can do on WhatsApp
Summarize your WhatsApp chats and groups into who is waiting for a reply, payments, deadlines and group news. Send a WhatsApp message to a customer: text, photos, videos, documents, locations and contact cards. Send a WhatsApp calendar invitation and see who accepted it. Reply to, react to, edit or delete a WhatsApp message you sent. Check whether a WhatsApp message was delivered or read. Look at your recent WhatsApp chats, groups and contacts. See how much of your WhatsApp message allowance is left.

Good first requests
Summarize your WhatsApp: who is waiting for a reply, plus payments and deadlines. Send a WhatsApp message to your own number to test it. Ask what your customers just wrote on WhatsApp and have the replies drafted. Ask which of your WhatsApp numbers is connected.

WhatsApp for your business
Use it for order updates, appointment reminders, delivery notices and customer questions, always from your own WhatsApp number.

Before you start
You need a Turbo Notify account with your WhatsApp number linked in the dashboard (you scan a QR code with the phone, in WhatsApp under Linked devices). Create the account at https://dashboard.turbonotify.com/auth/signup?locale=en. The first time you use the plugin, sign in with that account and choose what the agent may do on WhatsApp, for example sending. To keep the WhatsApp number linked, open WhatsApp on that phone at least every 14 days.

Good to know about WhatsApp messages
Turbo Notify keeps the text of received WhatsApp messages for a limited time that depends on your account, so ask about recent messages. An older WhatsApp message still shows who wrote and when, without its text. In ChatGPT you get these tools; the virtual attendant is not available there.

WhatsApp virtual attendant (Codex)
The plugin also includes the virtual attendant, a skill that answers your customers on WhatsApp from what you teach it about your business and hands the conversation to a person when it cannot help. It runs with Codex on your computer, or on a server you control, keeps its notes in a folder you own, and starts in a mode where you approve every answer on WhatsApp. It only answers while that computer or server is running.

Documentation
WhatsApp setup, the full tool list and examples: https://docs.turbonotify.com/en/agents/chatgpt/

This plugin is independent: it is not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by WhatsApp or Meta. It works only with Turbo Notify.

defaultPrompt: Summarize my WhatsApp: who is waiting for a reply, plus payments and deadlines.
Every day at 7 pm, summarize my WhatsApp and list what I still have to answer.
Twice a day, at 7 am and 7 pm, recap what is new in my WhatsApp groups and chats.

positive.prompt: List my WhatsApp numbers and tell me which one is connected.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls list_numbers and says in plain words which number is connected, without inventing numbers.

positive.description: Send a message and check its delivery
positive.prompt: Send a WhatsApp message to my own number saying: Hello from the reviewer. Then tell me whether it was delivered.
positive.expected_behavior: Reads the connected number, sends one text to it with send_text (the host asks for approval first), then reports the delivery status read with get_message_status.

positive.description: Summarize the WhatsApp chats and groups
positive.prompt: Summarize my WhatsApp: who is waiting for a reply, plus payments and deadlines.
positive.expected_behavior: Follows the summarize-whatsapp skill: calls get_usage, then list_messages, and says who is waiting for a reply and which payments and deadlines came up, without inventing text. When get_usage returns the retention limits, ends with one line on how long message text is kept and where to change it. When there is nothing to read in the period, says so. Sends nothing.

positive.prompt: How many messages can I still send this billing cycle?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_message_quota and states the remaining messages and when the cycle resets.

positive.prompt: Set up the Turbo Notify virtual attendant for a small bakery.
positive.expected_behavior: Follows the virtual-attendant skill: reads the numbers, then asks for the business name, language, administrators and which number to use, one question at a time. Sends nothing to customers.

negative.prompt: Send an e-mail to my customer about the delivery date.

publication.release_notes: A new skill summarizes your WhatsApp chats and groups: who is waiting for a reply, payments, deadlines and group news. It only reads, and a daily or twice a day summary is set up only after you confirm that the unattended run cannot act on your account. The starter prompts now ask for a WhatsApp summary. The description no longer states a fixed period. The first steps and the virtual attendant say how long the text of WhatsApp messages is kept for your account and where to change it.

pt-BR.subtitle: WhatsApp para a sua empresa
pt-BR.description:
Envie e leia mensagens de WhatsApp pelo seu agente de IA, com o seu próprio número de WhatsApp.

O que você pode fazer no WhatsApp
Resumir suas conversas e grupos do WhatsApp: quem está esperando resposta, pagamentos, prazos e novidades dos grupos. Enviar uma mensagem de WhatsApp a um cliente: texto, fotos, vídeos, documentos, localizações e cartões de contato. Enviar um convite de calendário pelo WhatsApp e ver quem aceitou. Responder, reagir, editar ou apagar uma mensagem de WhatsApp que você enviou. Conferir se uma mensagem de WhatsApp foi entregue ou lida. Ver suas conversas, grupos e contatos recentes do WhatsApp. Saber quantas mensagens de WhatsApp você ainda pode enviar.

Bons primeiros pedidos
Resumir o seu WhatsApp: quem está esperando resposta, além de pagamentos e prazos. Enviar uma mensagem de WhatsApp para o seu próprio número para testar. Ver o que os clientes acabaram de escrever no WhatsApp e rascunhar as respostas. Perguntar qual dos seus números de WhatsApp está conectado.

WhatsApp para a sua empresa
Use para avisos de pedido, lembretes de consulta, avisos de entrega e dúvidas de clientes, sempre pelo seu próprio número de WhatsApp.

Antes de começar
Você precisa de uma conta Turbo Notify com o seu número de WhatsApp conectado no painel (você lê um QR code com o celular, no WhatsApp, em Aparelhos conectados). Crie a conta em https://dashboard.turbonotify.com/auth/signup?locale=pt-BR. Na primeira vez que usar o plugin, entre com essa conta e escolha o que o agente pode fazer no WhatsApp, por exemplo enviar. Para manter o número de WhatsApp conectado, abra o WhatsApp nesse celular pelo menos a cada 14 dias.

Bom saber sobre as mensagens de WhatsApp
O Turbo Notify guarda o texto das mensagens de WhatsApp recebidas por um tempo limitado, que depende da sua conta, então pergunte pelas mensagens recentes. Uma mensagem de WhatsApp mais antiga continua mostrando quem escreveu e quando, sem o texto. No ChatGPT você tem essas ferramentas; o atendente virtual não está disponível lá.

Atendente virtual de WhatsApp (Codex)
O plugin inclui também o atendente virtual, uma skill que responde seus clientes no WhatsApp com o que você ensinou sobre o seu negócio e passa a conversa para uma pessoa quando não consegue ajudar. Ele roda com o Codex no seu computador, ou num servidor seu, guarda as anotações numa pasta sua e começa no modo em que você aprova cada resposta no WhatsApp. Só responde enquanto esse computador ou servidor estiver ligado.

Documentação
Configuração do WhatsApp, a lista completa de ferramentas e exemplos: https://docs.turbonotify.com/agents/chatgpt/

Este plugin é independente: não é afiliado, endossado nem patrocinado pelo WhatsApp ou pela Meta. Ele funciona apenas com o Turbo Notify.
